scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm just checking on the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application was approved, and the loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae. You were approved for an FHA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Can you tell me what my interest rate and the total costs of this loan are? Also, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.5%. The total costs associated with the loan are $9,443.50. The loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you. What is my debt-to-income ratio, and how does that affect my application? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio. The loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you confirm the loan term and the loan amount I was approved for? Also, was a preapproval requested for this loan?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a loan amount of $315,000 with a loan term of 360 months. A preapproval was not requested for this loan.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I think that covers everything I needed to know. I feel satisfied with the interaction and the information provided.

<Satisfied> - The agent provided clear and honest answers to all of my questions, and I felt well-informed about the status and details of my loan application.
